snippet.title: Shuttle Hearts - Academy Smash | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Shuttle Hearts - Academy Smash is a fast-paced 2D arcade-style badminton game where girls from all kinds of school clubs take to the court with unique abilities and spectacular special moves!

Mix lobs, clears, drops, drives, and smashes to control the rally, then build SP to unleash character-specific SP Shots and SP Skills.

Play as a colorful cast including the Go-Home Club, Athletics Club, Karate Club, Art Club, Cooking Club, Occult Club, and more, each with their own unique abilities and playstyle.

Enjoy character-specific stories, matches against CPU opponents, 2-player local multiplayer on a single PC, and online multiplayer battles!
Challenge your friends to wild badminton matches filled with unique abilities and over-the-top special moves!

To make the characters' stories and interactions accessible to more players around the world, the game now supports **14 languages**, including Japanese and English!

🏸 Free Demo Available Now on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4988110/

📅 Releases November 14, 2026
Wishlist now on Steam!

🌐 Official Website
https://nodaruki.github.io/gakuen-badoru-site/?lang=en

𝕏 NodarukiGames
https://x.com/nodarukigames
